subject: MAP draft and weekly checkpoint: Stratus Health onboarding
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@stratushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap + MAP draft (v0.2)

Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and next steps so we have shared clarity on the path to a pilot: 

Summary from today
- Primary use case: triage-assist for clinical intake (short answers + routing)
- Success metric: 40% reduction in intake deflection within pilot
- Primary constraint: must pass internal security review; procurement timeline uncertain

Attached: MAP-Stratus-v0.2.xlsx (draft) and SOW-Stratus-draft.pdf (scope draft).

Proposed MAP milestones (high level) — please review and mark owners where needed:
1) Security questionnaire completion — Owner: Stratus security (requested) — target: 2/24
2) Data ingestion & sample subset delivered to Redwood sandbox — Owner: Stratus / IT — target: 3/3
3) Integration demo + validation — Owner: Redwood (Dev) + Stratus PO — target: 3/17
4) Pilot sign-off / procurement approval — Owner: Stratus procurement — target close: 4/15

Open questions from my side:
- Do you have a security contact I can loop in (name + email)?
- Are there procurement blackout dates in March?

Ask: please confirm owners and any dependencies by 2/17 so I can circulate MAP v0.3.

Thanks — I’ll check in next Tuesday with a short progress update.

Regards,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Senior Solutions Lead
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com | (415) 555-0182
Attachments: MAP-Stratus-v0.2.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOW-Stratus-draft.pdf (pdf)

From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@stratushealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@stratushealth.com>, Ethan Zhou <ethan.zhou@stratushealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft (v0.2)

Hi Karthik —

Appreciate the clear recap. A couple of notes from our side after a quick internal sync: 

- Procurement would like the SOW to call out the data retention period explicitly (we typically do 90/180 day options). I attached our procurement checklist for reference.
- Security review: can we move "Security questionnaire completion" earlier in the MAP? Our security team (cc'd: Ethan Zhou) prefers to complete the questionnaire before sandbox data is shared.
- Target close: procurement indicated mid-April looks feasible but they need the SOW and security answers by early March to make that timeline.

Olivia
Olivia Barnes | Head of Clinical Operations
Stratus Health
olivia@stratushealth.com | +1 617-555-3321
Attachments: Stratus-Procurement-Checklist.xlsx

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood-inference.com>, Ethan Zhou <ethan.zhou@stratushealth.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Updated MAP v0.3 and revised milestones (security-first)

Olivia / team —

Thanks for the quick reply and the checklist — that helped. I updated the MAP to reflect security-first sequencing and added the procurement retention options. Attached: MAP-Stratus-v0.3.xlsx and an updated SOW excerpt (SOW-Stratus-draft.pdf).

Key changes in v0.3:
- Security questionnaire moved to top: Owner: Stratus security (Ethan) — target: 3/3
- Sandbox data handoff rescheduled to 3/10 (depends on security sign-off)
- Added procurement retention options (90/180 days) and a procurement review milestone: Owner: Procurement — target: 3/10
- Proposed pilot target close: 2026-04-15 (conditional on procurement sign-off)

Request: please review v0.3 and confirm the following by 3/3 so we can keep the April target:
- Security contact confirmation + timeline (Ethan, can you confirm?)
- Procurement point-person to review SOW retention clause
- Any internal blackout dates in March

If I don’t hear back by end of day 3/3 I’ll assume the dates are acceptable and will proceed to lock in resource reservations on our side (sandbox + engineer time).

Best,
Karthik
Attachments: MAP-Stratus-v0.3.xlsx, SOW-Stratus-draft.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@stratushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood-inference.com>, Procurement <procurement@stratushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Weekly checkpoint — actions overdue / updated MAP attached

Team —

Quick weekly checkpoint. I’ve attached the latest MAP (v0.3) again below for convenience. High level status: 

- Security questionnaire: still awaiting answers (originally requested by 3/3) — ACTION: Ethan / Stratus security
- Procurement review of SOW retention clause: pending (Procurement) — ACTION: Procurement
- Sandbox data: blocked until security sign-off — blocked

If any of these dates look off or if you need us to fill information in the questionnaire directly, we can draft answers on our side (happy to do that to keep the timeline).

Proposed near-term milestones if we get security answers by 3/3 and procurement review by 3/10:
- 3/10: Sandbox handoff
- 3/17: Integration demo (internal + Stratus PO)
- 4/15: Pilot sign-off / procurement approval (target close)

Please reply with short updates (one-liners are fine). If I don’t get a reply by EOD 3/3 I’ll mark Security and Procurement as delayed and propose new target dates in next checkpoint.

Thanks —
Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Senior Solutions Lead
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com
Attachments: MAP-Stratus-v0.3.xlsx

From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@stratushealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Weekly checkpoint — actions overdue / updated MAP attached

Karthik —

Thanks for the nudge and for consolidating. Quick updates: 
- Security: Ethan here — I’ll turn around the questionnaire answers by 3/10 (we had resource constraints this week; apologies). If Redwood can draft an initial set, please do and I’ll annotate.
- Procurement: procurement@stratushealth.com confirms they will review the SOW retention clause by 3/10; they asked for a redline-friendly SOW (I think the PDF you sent should work but I’ll push them to use the spreadsheet).
- No March blackout dates.

That shifts things slightly but still keeps April 15 as an achievable target if security + procurement meet the 3/10 dates. We’ll aim for that.

Olivia
Olivia Barnes | Head of Clinical Operations
Stratus Health
olivia@stratushealth.com
